title: ClawGUI: Unified Framework for Training and Deploying GUI Agents
summary: An open-source, full-stack framework for the entire lifecycle of GUI agents, covering reinforcement learning training, standardized evaluation, and cross-platform deployment. It enables agents to control Android, iOS, and HarmonyOS devices using advanced policy optimization and process reward models.
research_notes: Developed by ZJU-REAL lab; includes a specialized Android application for on-device deployment using Shizuku.

evolution.summary: Released in April 2026, the framework addresses the fragmentation in GUI agent research by providing a unified pipeline from training to production. The included ClawGUI-2B model currently outperforms significantly larger models like UI-Venus-72B on major benchmarks.
